headline: Protein language models are probed for invariance failures while biophysical priors are added
label: Protein Model Probing And Biophysical
summary: New preprints expose protein language model failures under relabeling and layer probing while adding dynamics, electrostatics and energy-based signals to variant and binding tasks.
synthesis: The dominant thread is scrutiny of what protein models actually encode, paired with injecting physical information to improve them. Language-model contact maps collapse under bijective amino-acid relabeling, unlike Potts and inverse-covariance methods, and OpenFold Evoformer layers are probed with decoders for distance decodability and triangle-inequality violations. In parallel, DynamicsPLM adds molecular dynamics heads, Biophysical Transformer pretrains on Poisson-Boltzmann electrostatic fields, and MutAtlas scores PDB-wide mutations with energy, language and inverse-folding models. Downstream applications include enzyme turnover (PAMP, EnzRef), PTM sites (HieraPTM) and ligand binding, benchmarked zero-shot or scored with BioLM-Score. Not all items address evaluation directly; the common move is combining language-model priors with structural or physical context.
